A '''ceremonial poleaxe''' was a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]] without a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]]. [[Dewt Kluskine]] armed his [[Honor guard (Dewt Kluskine)|honor guard]] with these weapons during his stint as the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|detention facility]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />
